newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola names food unit Minute Maid Co.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola names food unit Minute Maid Co.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said Monday that it has renamed its foods division for its trademark juice brand, Minute Maid.

The renaming of the Coca-Cola Foods division as Minute Maid Co follows Coca-Cola's other efforts to highlight its juice brand, including the announcement in September of a joint venture with France's Danone Group to market juices in Europe and Latin America.
Coca-Cola juice products include Minute Maid, Hi-C, Five Alive and Bright & Early.
